description:
Base on-chain read: the latest block number. Health-check ping for Base: returns the latest Base block number from a live RPC read. A fast liveness and sync check with no query parameters.

GET https://api.arysphere.com/v1/ventures/x402_chain_reads_v1/health_ping. Same payment terms as that HTTP route.
Call once with no payment. The result is the payment terms. Retry the same call with the signed payment at _meta["x402/payment"].
name: x402_chain_reads_v1__health_ping
